clusters.title: Khongsngi / Lyngdoh Mawphlang / Rapthap / Thawmuit
clusters.summary_khasi: Baroh kine ki dei ki khun ka Khmah Lyngdoh Mawphlang (bad ha Riangmang la khot 'Kyllang'). Ki Lyngdoh Sangriang ruh ki ïadei kur bad ki.
